contract_clause: P-ENVELOPE-STRICT-LENGTH: decode_record_payload rejects input slices where bytes.len() != RECORD_HEADER_BYTES + header.payload_len with JournalError::UnexpectedTrailingBytes { declared_end, actual_len } (or UnexpectedEof for truncation).
expected_outcome: Any input slice where bytes.len() strictly exceeds RECORD_HEADER_BYTES + declared payload_len returns UnexpectedTrailingBytes with exact declared_end and actual_len; equal lengths accept; shorter lengths return UnexpectedEof. Existing Kani harnesses already prove both directions.

contract_clause: P-ENVELOPE-DIGEST: decode_record_payload calls verify_digest_match and returns PayloadDigestMismatch on mismatch; put_workflow_source and put_compiled_ir call verify_content_digest before insert and reject with PayloadDigestMismatch on mismatch.
expected_outcome: Any envelope whose blake3(payload) does not equal header.payload_digest returns PayloadDigestMismatch at decode time; any put whose blake3(record.source) does not equal record.digest returns PayloadDigestMismatch before any key derivation or insert.

contract_clause: P-COMPILED-IR-METADATA-IMMUTABLE: put_compiled_ir rejects a second write under the same digest whose metadata_hash disagrees with the existing record; first write passes; same-metadata re-write is idempotent.
expected_outcome: Same digest with diverged metadata returns Err(JournalError::MetadataMutation { digest }); same digest with identical metadata_hash is accepted; first write is accepted unconditionally. No partial state on the partition key.

contract_clause: P-DIGEST-CHECK-STRICT-ORDERING: DigestCheck::hierarchy_rank is strictly monotonic across all variants; checks_workflow_source / checks_compiled_ir / checks_full are rank-derived.
expected_outcome: For all three DigestCheck variants, rank(WorkflowSourceOnly)=1 < rank(WorkflowAndIr)=2 < rank(Full)=3; checks_* predicates agree with rank derivation exactly; Full is the strictest level.

contract_clause: P-FULL-DIGEST-FAIL-CLOSED: verify_digests at DigestCheck::Full returns Err(FullDigestCheckConfigMissing) when config is None OR cfg.action_abi_entries is None OR cfg.policy_entries is None. Empty slices are accepted (no entries to verify).
existing_tests: crates/vb_storage/src/recovery/tests.rs:1835-1911 (Full with full config, Full missing action entries, Full missing policy entries, WorkflowAndIr ignores config)
expected_outcome: For level=Full: config=None, action_abi_entries=None, or policy_entries=None all return FullDigestCheckConfigMissing. For level<Full: config unused; verification passes through to workflow/IR checks only.

contract_clause: P-FULL-DIGEST-FAIL-CLOSED: check_action_abi_digests returns Err(ActionAbiMismatch { action_id, expected, found }) on the FIRST mismatched entry; check_policy_digests returns Err(PolicyDigestMismatch { step, expected, found }) on the FIRST mismatched entry. Empty slices return Ok.
expected_outcome: Action ABI slice with at least one mismatched (action_id, expected, found) triple returns ActionAbiMismatch with the first mismatch's triple; Policy slice analogously returns PolicyDigestMismatch. Empty slices return Ok.

contract_clause: P-KIND-ID-STABLE: RecordKind::StepSucceeded has wire id 29; RecordKind::SlotWritten has wire id 12; record_kind() on the two JournalEvent variants maps injectively.
expected_outcome: StepSucceeded.record_kind() == StepSucceeded (id 29); SlotWrittenEvent.record_kind() == SlotWritten (id 12); the two values are distinct. proof-planner should extend the harness to cover ALL RecordKind variants for full injectivity.

contract_clause: P-KIND-FAMILY-INVARIANT: (MAGIC_RECOVERY_STAMP, kind=7) is the only valid pair for recovery stamps; recovery stamps are rejected under MAGIC_JOURNAL_EVENT; workflow source / compiled IR kinds are rejected under MAGIC_RECOVERY_STAMP.
expected_outcome: Each magic admits exactly the kinds in its family; cross-family decoding fails with JournalError::KindFamilyMismatch. This is a cross-family coverage check adjacent to the four named beads.
